The '''''Salin Mariner''''' was a "C-One" [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] that was operating by [[Salin Excursions]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the ''Mariner'' undertook a cruise from [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] to [[Botajef/Legends|Botajef]]. During the voyage, the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was sabotaged by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who then kidnapped several of the liner's passengers.<ref name="Insider144" />
